title: NVIDIA buys $10 billion of Anthropic stock in IPO private placement

sources.quote: Based on the initial public offering price of $83.00 per share, Google LLC will purchase 120,481,927 shares of our Class N common stock for approximately $10.0 billion, NVIDIA Corporation (“NVIDIA”) will purchase 120,481,927 shares of our Class N common stock for approximately $10.0 billion, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.

explain: Alongside Anthropic's stock-market debut, NVIDIA agreed to buy about $10 billion of Anthropic's Class N shares at the IPO price, in a private placement that closes right after the offering.
